products.alt: Lit tea light glowing inside a hand-carved Himalayan pink salt candle holder, on a grey background

description: A tea light holder carved by hand from a single piece of natural Himalayan pink salt. When the candle is lit, the salt glows a soft, warm amber, adding a calm, cosy light to a living room, bedroom, bathroom or yoga corner.

Because each one is cut from natural salt crystal, no two are exactly alike: the colour, texture and shape vary a little from piece to piece, so yours is one of a kind. It comes with a candle, so it is ready to light, and makes a thoughtful gift.
details: Hand-carved from natural Himalayan pink salt
Comes with one candle (the style of candle varies)
Holds one tea light, flameless LED tea light or small votive at a time
Each holder is unique, so the colour, shape and size vary slightly from the photos
One candle holder per order. The other holders, gift box and items shown in the photos are not included
Keep it somewhere dry, as salt can absorb moisture from damp air
Never leave a burning candle unattended, and keep it away from anything that can catch fire

description: A round, textured white tray with two cups and a little incense holder, made to keep everything for a cleansing or meditation ritual in one place. The larger cup holds a white sage bundle or a tea light, the smaller cup holds a palo santo stick, and the round holder takes a standard incense stick.
Its soft, stone-like finish suits an altar, a yoga corner, a bedside table or a bathroom shelf, and the wide base catches ash and dripping wax.

description: Everything you need to look after your candles, in a warm rose gold finish. Trim the wick before each burn for a cleaner, brighter flame with less smoke and soot, use the dipper to straighten the wick or dip it into the melted wax, and put the flame out with the bell snuffer without blowing smoke or splashing wax.
The tools rest together on a matching oval tray, so they look neat on a coffee table, shelf or bathroom vanity, and the set makes an easy gift for any candle lover.
